name.description: Bucket name. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 40 characters. Must be unique.

team.description: Owning team. Becomes the team tag.

cost_center.description: Cost center that pays for it. Becomes the cost-center tag.

versioning.description: Keep previous versions of overwritten and deleted objects.

retention.description: How long noncurrent object versions are kept before they expire. Only meaningful with versioning.
